get_grant_api_v1_identity_grants__grant_.ui_client: The folder access tab lists and revokes grants from the folder's grant list (GET /folders/{folder_id}/grants); a single-grant read is for API clients and pipelines that keep a grant id.

list_cards_route_api_v1_contracts_folder.ui_client: The Cards screen uses the all-cards list (GET /cards) with its folder filter, which also covers the subtree and the caller's member cards; the per-folder list stays for API clients.

validate_on_demand_api_v1_validation_fol.ui_client: Pipeline-facing: engineers validate a local contract file against a folder's rules from CI. The UI validates drafts through POST /contracts/{contract_id}/drafts/{draft_id}/validate, which calls the same validation run.
